positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: Voted yes on the Family Zoning Plan zoning map ordinance (File No. 250700) on first reading on December 2, 2025 and at final passage on December 9, 2025; in his GrowSF questionnaire he says the plan struck a good balance.

citations.quote: Ayes: 7 - Dorsey, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill and Wong
citations.locator: p. 72, legislative history, December 02, 2025, passed on first reading

citations.quote: Ayes: 6 - Dorsey, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter and Sherrill
citations.locator: p. 72, legislative history, December 09, 2025, final passage

citations.quote: The Family Zoning Plan struck a good balance, but there’s always more that can be done when it comes to housing.
citations.locator: Housing: Do you think Mayor Lurie’s Family zoning plan is too ambitious or not ambitious enough?

positions.subject: q:public-health/end-drug-use-supply-distribution
positions.summary: Says harm reduction supplies must be part of a broader strategy to move people into treatment and recovery, and supports Mayor Lurie's effort to require that distribution of these supplies, including safer smoking supplies, be accompanied by efforts to get users into recovery; he does not call for ending distribution.

citations.quote: Harm reduction is an incremental step that must be viewed as part of a broader strategy to incentivize and, if necessary, coerce and mandate people into drug treatment and recovery.
citations.locator: Substance abuse: Would you continue or change the city’s harm reduction policies that distribute drug use paraphernalia beyond clean needles, such as pipes, foil, etc.?

citations.quote: I support Mayor Lurie’s efforts to require that the distribution of harm-reduction supplies — including safer smoking supplies — be accompanied by efforts to get drug users into recovery.

positions.subject: q:public-safety/police-license-plate-cameras
positions.summary: Told the SF Standard he supports renewing the city's contract with Flock because he considers the concerns speculative, and that he would reconsider if problems emerge.

citations.quote: That said, he supports renewing the contract with Flock because he thinks the concerns are speculative.
citations.locator: Flock-ing together in support: Supervisor Matt Dorsey

citations.quote: He said he would reconsider if problems emerge with the contract, but overall, the cameras are working.
citations.locator: Flock-ing together in support: Supervisor Matt Dorsey
